honest_summary: This batch does not reach 500 products, and it does not pad to get there. Nutrition-evidenced records come from the existing PKG-001 batch; everything added here is identity-and-GTIN only, because the authoritative nutrition sources are unreachable from this environment (see environment_constraint).

reachable: web search (result titles and snippets only)
environment_constraint.consequence: Product identity and GTIN could be evidenced from search result listings. Per-product nutrition panels could not be read, so they are null rather than guessed. The app already ships a runtime Open Food Facts seed (src/features/products/saudiSeed.ts) that will populate nutrition on a network-enabled device.
environment_constraint.what_unblocks_500: Allow-list world.openfoodfacts.org (and ideally the brand domains almarai.com, nadec.com.sa, nada-me.com, sadafco.com), then re-run this builder: the OFF Saudi facet alone returns hundreds of products with GTIN plus nutrition in one query.

priority: 4. Open Food Facts where identity matches
source_policy.rule: Manufacturer nutrition beats retailer transcription. A retailer or an OFF listing may establish existence and identity without becoming authoritative for nutrition.
never: copy nutrition from another flavour or pack size
treat a different-GTIN pack size as the same product
use fuzzy name matching as identity proof
attach an image of a different variant

integrity_checks: السكر ≤ الكربوهيدرات · الدهن المشبع ≤ الدهن الكلي.
نطاق طاقة معقول لكل فئة (حليب 28–85 · جبن 120–420 · شيبس 430–580 …).
**قاعدة سادسة عند وجود مصدرين:** يُقاس التباعد بينهما، والتباعد فوق 8% يُخرج الصنف إلى «يحتاج مراجعة».

gtin_validation.method: EAN-13 check digit plus GS1 prefix classification
gtin_validation.caveat: Prefix identifies the registering company, not the country of manufacture or sale.

duplicates_removed.dropped: Almarai lacto free milk full fat

rejected.reason: GTIN fails the EAN-13 check digit and the prefix is not a real GS1 assignment — a junk entry in the source. Rejected outright.
Prefix 428 is South Korea. A Saudi L'usine bakery item cannot carry it — almost certainly a mis-keyed barcode. Rejected: inferring the "right" barcode would be inventing one.
Prefix 622 is Egypt. Almarai Egypt is a different market with a possibly different formulation — not the Saudi product, and treating it as such would be fuzzy matching.

rejected.name_as_listed: White meat tuna — Al Alali 85 g
rejected.reason: Prefix 061 is a US/Canada GS1 assignment, which does not fit a Saudi Al Alali pack. Held back pending a shelf check rather than admitted on name match alone.

rejected.name_as_listed: Sadia breaded chicken golden steak 100 g
rejected.reason: Prefix 789 is Brazil, which is consistent with Sadia being Brazilian, but the listing does not establish it is the pack sold in Saudi Arabia. Kept out of the Saudi set until confirmed.

items: Coca-Cola Light / Diet Coke (KSA, where sold)
unresolved_high_priority.why: Open Food Facts listings for these brands return Indian (890), Polish (590), Mexican (750) and US (0012000) barcodes — other markets with potentially different formulations. No Saudi-registered (628) entry surfaced. Treating a foreign pack as the Saudi one would be exactly the fuzzy match the brief forbids.
Same as above; PKG-001 also recorded energy drinks as an open category gap.
Only US-registered Aquafina entries surfaced. Berain is covered in identity_leads; Nova and Nestlé Pure Life returned no Saudi entry.
All Indomie entries carry Indonesian/global (0089686) or Serbian (860) prefixes. No Saudi-registered pack surfaced.
No Saudi-registered entries surfaced. PKG-001 carries one evidenced Lay's salted 155 g pack; the rest are unevidenced.
Imported confectionery is registered under the manufacturer's home prefix, so a Saudi-market pack cannot be identified from a listing alone.
A dedicated search returned no Saudi-registered frozen chicken entries; the only hits were UK, US and Brazilian products. Herfy chicken burger is in identity_leads.

items: Whey and sports protein sold in KSA
unresolved_high_priority.why: PKG-001 already recorded sports protein as needing a shelf reading; nothing new was reachable here.
